name: PCI - High
description: PCI: bulk credit card data. Ten or more card numbers (predefined Credit Cards dictionary) in one file or transfer.

name: PCI - Medium
description: PCI: several credit card numbers (3-9) in one file or transfer, predefined Credit Cards dictionary.

name: PCI - Low
